note: What a Codex run keeps of the caller's environment. Names listed, or starting with a listed prefix, are dropped whatever their value. This keeps the user's own Codex login as the only credential. The recording (recorded/FINDINGS.md) ran with OPENAI_API_KEY, CODEX_API_KEY and OPENAI_BASE_URL unset, but it does not show that Codex reads them, nor the ORG and PROJECT names: those are the plan's choice, unverified. CODEX_HOME is kept, because the user's login lives there. On Windows names compare without regard to case.

cases.name: the OpenAI variables are dropped and the login folder is kept
on Windows a lower-case name is dropped too
on macOS and Linux names are case-sensitive
